update.title: A new version of Aphel is available
update.description: Update to load the latest improvements. Anything unsaved on this screen may be lost.

push.title: Push notifications on this device
push.enabledDescription: On: you get the notices checked in the Push column even when Aphel is closed.
push.disabledDescription: Get the notices checked in the Push column even when Aphel is closed. Applies only to this browser and is turned off when you sign out.
push.blocked: Notifications for this site are blocked in the browser settings. Allow them there to turn this on.
push.enabled: Push notifications turned on for this device
push.enableError: Could not turn on push notifications
push.disableError: Could not turn off push notifications

support.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
support.ios-needs-install: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work with Aphel installed: tap Share → Add to Home Screen, open Aphel from the icon and turn them on here.
support.development: Push notifications only work in the built version of Aphel (not on the development server).
